items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 25:1
items.html: Since GAR of Nekudim were likewise not complete, and they too were corrected by this coupling of the Rosh of Atik, which is the phase of their male, they therefore held it in their place. (Note from our master the author: This is not necessary at all, for Atik is the first head of Atzilut, like Yeshsut of Nekudim, and hence its place is from the end of Tifferet of Nekudim to the navel, equal to GAR of Nekudim.) (Inner Light, page 611, Sub Header, “And Indeed”)
